OCR_SQLITE_PATH.description: Absolute path to an existing protected directory's SQLite file. Startup self-check never creates the database.

OCR_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Externally provisioned Fernet key. Never store in source control, schema instances, logs, or chat. Self-check validates format only and never generates a key.

OCR_DET_MODEL_PATH.description: Absolute path to pre-staged detector ONNX model; no runtime download.

OCR_REC_MODEL_PATH.description: Absolute path to pre-staged recognizer ONNX model; no runtime download.

OCR_CLS_MODEL_PATH.description: Absolute path to pre-staged angle classifier ONNX model; no runtime download.

OCR_BINDING_CALLBACKS_READY.description: For offline-preparation only. This schema does not configure or authorize production callbacks.
